title: Defending Aden, Yemen’s Holdout Against the Houthis
summary_full: The war in Iran has reignited Yemen’s decade-old civil war. Saudi-backed troops are scrambling to defend against advancing Houthi fighters as the wounded are taken to the port city of Aden, the government’s provisional capital.
